risk: The engine is not as the listing says: low or uneven compression, coolant in the oil, metal in the pan
fallback: Stop before any car money is spent: claim under the seller's terms if they apply, else resell the package (about the freight and a resale gap lost) or rebuild the BP at home
note: The seller compression-tests every engine and lists 61,000 miles; a home install voids the warranty (S-612), so the ceiling is a rebuild

risk: The timing belt is old or worn
fallback: A new belt (and the water pump only if it weeps), EN03
note: The belt's age is unknown on a 1994-97 engine

risk: The engine is the other year than planned for (1994-95 cam sensor only, or 1996-97 with a crank sensor and a downstream O2)
fallback: Both are designed for (bp_devices year column): the crank sensor's two conductors and the downstream O2's bung are used or capped

risk: The BP's coil pack has no igniter of its own
fallback: The EMU Black drives up to 6 passive coils directly; if not, an external igniter
note: Confirm against the EMU Black's manual (electrical Y87)

risk: The 5-speed's output spline does not match the yard Miata yoke found
fallback: A new slip yoke to the counted spline, from a driveshaft supplier
note: Every NA 5-speed shares its output; the count is read at BD15

risk: The gear lever lands outside the FB's tunnel opening, or the case fouls the tunnel
fallback: Move the floor opening (cut, plate, seal) or set the gearbox's position at DS07 to suit; a shifter extension only if neither works
note: D-652: the tunnel is measured only once the automatic is out; the CAD uses the factory body with a 15 mm margin, and J4 re-checks before any cut

risk: The BP's sump fouls the FB crossmember or steering linkage at the height the hood allows
fallback: Raise or set back the engine within the hood's clearance (DS07); else section and re-weld the pan's sump
note: CD06 proves it on forum figures with a margin; CD08 re-checks on the parts

risk: The BP's stock manifold fouls the FB's steering box or linkage
fallback: A 4-2-1 header made or bought to clear (DS03's fallback)
note: LHD Miata manifolds sit on the same side as the FB's box - confirm in CAD

risk: The head or cam cover hits the hood
fallback: Lower or set back the engine (DS07); a hood is luxury's only as a last resort
note: The 12A sat low; the BP is taller - the hood's underside height is part of M01

risk: The BP's own alternator cannot carry W1's or W2's load
fallback: The FD 100 A on the BP's bracket (its fitting work is known, AC02)
note: A rough night-rain-idle sum is close to 70 A

risk: The starter or the clutch slave is not on the package
fallback: Buy them: a remanufactured Miata starter and the Dorman slave (CL07)
note: The photos show the gearbox bolted on; the seller confirms

risk: The kept clutch is worn or slips
fallback: The Exedy OE kit (CL05) and a flywheel resurface (CL06) - the gearbox comes out from below by design (D-640)

risk: The FB tank's top opening does not take the universal hanger
fallback: A sender plate made to the opening, or a different hanger
note: DS12 measures it before buying the pump

risk: The oil filter cannot be reached past the FB frame rail
fallback: A remote filter mount with two short lines

risk: The referee asks for a specific converter or the downstream O2 on a 1994-95 engine
fallback: A named-brand EPA converter (EM01) and a downstream bung - already in the W2 plan
note: BP02 answered: tested as the engine's year (D-635)
